title: TCS Technical Interview Round
description: Evaluates programming fundamentals, Object-Oriented Programming, DBMS, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, and language-specific mastery.

codingProblem.title: Pair Sum Equilibrium
codingProblem.description: Given an array of integers and a target value K, write an efficient function in your chosen language to find all unique pairs whose sum equals K. Analyze the time and space complexity of your approach.

questions.question: Can you explain how memory is managed in your chosen language? Specifically, what is the difference between stack and heap memory, and how are objects allocated and deallocated?

keyConcepts: Stack for local variables & call frames
Automatic Garbage Collection vs manual free/delete
rubric.followUp: What happens in your language when the heap memory runs out?

questions.question: Explain the four pillars of Object-Oriented Programming with a real-world software design example. How does runtime polymorphism differ from compile-time polymorphism?

rubric.followUp: Can an abstract class have constructors in your language? Why or why not?

questions.question: What are ACID properties in relational database transactions? Why are indexes used, and what data structures are typically used to implement database indexes?

keyConcepts: Tradeoff between read speed and write overhead
rubric.followUp: What is the difference between TRUNCATE and DELETE in SQL?

questions.question: What is the difference between a process and a thread? Explain the conditions required for a deadlock to occur, and how an operating system can prevent or resolve them.

keyConcepts: Process has isolated address space; threads share process memory
Mutual Exclusion, Hold and Wait, No Preemption, Circular Wait
rubric.followUp: What is thrashing in the context of virtual memory and paging?

questions.question: Walk me through what happens under the hood when a user types 'https://codevita.tcsapps.com' into a browser and hits Enter. Mention the protocols involved at different layers.

rubric.followUp: Why is TCP preferred over UDP for web browsing, while UDP is preferred for live video streaming?

questions.question: Compare the average and worst-case time complexities of QuickSort, MergeSort, and HeapSort. In what practical scenarios would you choose QuickSort over MergeSort?

keyConcepts: MergeSort O(N log N) guaranteed, O(N) extra space
QuickSort O(N log N) average, O(N^2) worst case, cache locality
rubric.followUp: How do you detect a cycle in a singly linked list in O(N) time and O(1) space?

questions.question: What is the difference between monolithic architecture and microservices? How do microservices communicate with each other reliably in production?

keyConcepts: REST APIs vs gRPC vs Message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ)
rubric.followUp: What is database connection pooling, and why is it essential for enterprise applications?
